test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-4) Official paper (Held On: 10 May 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
A, B, C, D, J, K, L and M are sitting around a square table facing the centre of the table. Four of them are sitting at either of the corners while the other four are sitting at the exact centre of either of the sides.

D sits at one of the corners of the table. Only one person sits between D and C. Only three people sit between C and B. M sits second to the right of B. K sits to the immediate left of M. A is NOT an immediate neighbour of B. Only three people sit between A and L. Who sits to the immediate right of J?
solution:
A, B, C, D, J, K, L and M are sitting around a square table facing the centre of the table. 

Four of them are sitting at either of the corners while the other four are sitting at the exact centre of either of the sides

1) D sits at one of the corners of the table and Only one person sits between D and C.

Case (i) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/65c2712221cac03c72ee9b794eaa4c4245881cb92dda0a4f4265117ecb2db956.png] 

Case (ii) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d986432a2e69dfdf284cddc4e7c64725dcee95f2bb80d63170ec98e2f69194b.png] 

2) Only three people sit between C and B.

Case (i) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c75404d761f2655399ec8341a3de04e0d6f1e21633eb9a6fdc0d5bf96a0f6f9f.png] 

Case (ii) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d03f5cec01a5be90b04320d780a00a4fcd6c9a695610c42983b084c9a2b370cb.png] 

3) M sits second to the right of B.

Here case (ii) gets eliminated.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e5dfe7f72dcff4af27c19918f7ec39b0fa72eda371d0ffe3391386a404366be8.png] 

4) K sits to the immediate left of M.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/af7ff544f5434cbda754a3633e5a32629c3eb000d0961b588fda72e29462bfbf.png] 

5) A is **NOT an immediate neighbour of B **and Only three people sit between A and L.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b0abc1f547ddd786b0a7d4fe259b245cc9abcc8f45dd98c096021a5dbf0f5914.png] 

Thus the final siting positions of all eight people is as follows :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d01bfc4235bda0e3b52fb6c833c3d956e6d1f12c0fc9c87995ffc544ac1e372c.png] 

∴ Here, **'D' sits to the immediate right of 'J'.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"D".**
